capabilities: Build slide decks from Markdown notes
Style slides with themes and annotations
Export presentations as PDF or HTML
extras: README is a short feature list that points to external documentation, a demo presentation, and a discussion forum for details; the author accepts donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into styled, exportable slide presentations.
summary: Markdown-based presentation builder that turns notes into slide decks with live preview, themes, and PDF or HTML export.
